concepts.title: 椭圆的轴与焦点
concepts.summary: 到两焦点距离之和为 $2a$；$a\ge b>0$。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 配方并把右侧化成1；大分母为 $a^2$，$c^2=a^2-b^2$。中心、顶点与短轴端点都须平移。

en.title: Ellipse axes and foci
en.summary: The sum of distances to two foci is $2a$, with $a\ge b>0$.

method.title: Method
method.body: Complete squares and normalize to 1. The larger denominator is $a^2$; $c^2=a^2-b^2$. Translate the center, vertices and minor-axis endpoints.

concepts.title: 双曲线与渐近线
concepts.summary: 到两焦点距离差的绝对值为 $2a$。

method.title: 方法
method.body: 正项确定实轴，$c^2=a^2+b^2$。$(x-h)^2/a^2-(y-k)^2/b^2=1$ 的渐近线为 $y-k=\pm(b/a)(x-h)$；竖直形式斜率为 $\pm a/b$。

en.title: Hyperbolas and asymptotes
en.summary: The absolute difference of distances to the two foci is $2a$.

method.title: Method
method.body: The positive term locates the transverse axis, and $c^2=a^2+b^2$. For $(x-h)^2/a^2-(y-k)^2/b^2=1$, asymptotes are $y-k=\pm(b/a)(x-h)$; the vertical form uses slopes $\pm a/b$.

exercises.prompt: K1：识别原图所示顶点V和焦点F确定的圆锥曲线，并求方程。坐标网格单位间隔为1。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 从原图读出中心为原点，水平轴上顶点距中心 $a=5$，焦距 $c=3$。

steps.title: 计算与推导
steps.body: 标准式为 $\frac{x^{2}}{25}+\frac{y^{2}}{16}=1$；图中画出原坐标下的实点集。

en.prompt: K 1: Identify and find the equation of the conic with vertices V and foci F shown in the original diagram. The axes are marked in one-unit intervals.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Read the original diagram: center at the origin, a horizontal axis with $a=5$ and $c=3$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: Complete both squares: $\frac{x^{2}}{25} + \frac{y^{2}}{16}=1$, with center $(0,0)$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The positive denominators give $a^2=25, b^2=16, c^2=a^2-b^2=9$. Vertices $(-5,0),\ (5,0)$; foci $(-3,0),\ (3,0)$; minor-axis endpoints $(0,-4),\ (0,4)$.

steps.title: Calculate and reason
steps.body: The standard form is $\frac{x^{2}}{25}+\frac{y^{2}}{16}=1$. The graph shows the real locus in the original coordinates.
